svg.title: Agenerela. The model decides. Validated code executes.
svg.desc: A village guard at night, with a glowing brain above him standing for the language model. He hears the player say "Go to the tower.", sees the tower and the bridge as targets, and recalls that the night watch began. His brain thinks; a menu offers move_to, talk and follow_player, with attack struck out as not legal now. He picks move_to, a line runs to the tower, and the game's MoveTo(tower) runs after a second check.
